records.jp: あ！　千紘！
日菜子……さん。<CR>この前は……あり……がとう
今日はもう帰り？<CR>良かったら一緒に帰らない？
records.en_original: Going home for the day? Want to go together?
records.en_auxiliary: Going home for the day? Want to go together?
records.en: Going home for the day? Want to go together?

records.jp: ……ごめん……なさい。今日は……あと……一か所……<CR>花壇の……様子……見たいから
records.en_original: ...I'm...sorry... Today...I want to...check one more flowerbed...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry. Today... I want to check one more flowerbed.
records.en: ...I'm...sorry... Today...I want to...check one more flowerbed...

records.jp: そっか、それじゃあ
あーあ、またあいつ花壇の世話してるよ
records.en_original: Sheesh, she's working on the flower beds again.
records.en_auxiliary: Sheesh, she's working on the flowerbeds again.
records.en: Sheesh, she's working on the flower beds again.

records.jp: ほんと、良く飽きないよねー毎日
records.en_original: Day in, day out, she never seems to get sick of it.
records.en_auxiliary: Day in, day out, she never seems to get sick of it.
records.en: Day in, day out, she never seems to get sick of it.

records.jp: いやいや、ほんとはもう飽きてるよ絶対。<CR>『私みんなのために頑張ってますよー』ってアピールだから。あれ
records.en_original: Oh, she's sick of it. It's just PR, like, "look how hard I'm working to improve everyone's lives!"
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, she's sick of it. It's just PR, like, "look how hard I'm working to improve everyone's lives!"
records.en: Oh, she's sick of it. It's just PR, like, "look how hard I'm working to improve everyone's lives!"

records.jp: ちょっと、あなたたち千紘の気持ちも知らないで勝手なこと言うの<CR>やめなさいよ
records.en_original: Hey, stop saying things like that. You have no idea how Chihiro feels.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, stop saying things like that. You have no idea how Chihiro feels.
records.en: Hey, stop saying things like that. You have no idea how Chihiro feels.

records.jp: はあ？　あんたには関係ないでしょ
records.en_original: What? This has nothing to do with you.
records.en_auxiliary: What? This has nothing to do with you.
records.en: What? This has nothing to do with you.

records.jp: 関係あるよ。千紘は私の大切な友達だもん……。<CR>それに私はいつでも千紘の味方だって約束したからね
records.en_original: Chihiro's my friend, so yeah, it does. I promised her that I'd always be on her side.
records.en_auxiliary: Chihiro's my friend, so yeah, it does. I promised her that I'd always be on her side.
records.en: Chihiro's my friend, so yeah, it does. I promised her that I'd always be on her side.

records.jp: ねえ！　千紘？
日菜子……さん……
フン……。マジでキモイんですけどこいつら……<CR>付き合ってらんないわ
records.en_original: Hmph... These two weirdos are seriously creepy... I'd rather not waste any more time anywhere near them.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmph... These two weirdos are seriously creeps. I'd rather not waste any more time anywhere near them.
records.en: Hmph... These two weirdos are seriously creepy... I'd rather not waste any more time anywhere near them.

records.jp: 行きましょう
ええ
危ない！
え！
あっ！
千紘！
井上！
誰か！　誰か来て！
どうしたの！？　大丈夫？
何か落ちて来て、気絶してるみたいなの！
records.en_original: Something came falling down, she's unconscious!
records.en_auxiliary: Something came falling down! She's unconscious!
records.en: Something came falling down, she's unconscious!

records.jp: 保健室へ運びましょう
records.en_original: We should carry her to the nurse's office.
records.en_auxiliary: We should carry her to the nurse's office.
records.en: We should carry her to the nurse's office.

records.jp: う、うん……
千紘……
井上……あたしのせいで……
千紘……大丈夫？<CR>どこか痛むところは？
records.en_original: Chihiro... Are you okay? Are you hurt anywhere?
records.en_auxiliary: Chihiro... Are you okay? Are you hurt anywhere?
records.en: Chihiro... Are you okay? Are you hurt anywhere?

records.jp: ……日菜子……さん……？<CR>わたしは……大丈夫……
それより……さっきの……人は？
井上……あたしなら無事だよ……。<CR>井上がかばってくれたおかげでこの通り……ありがとう……
records.en_original: Inoue... I'm fine... It's because you shielded me... Thank you...
records.en_auxiliary: Inoue, I'm fine. Because you shielded me... Thank you.
records.en: Inoue... I'm fine... It's because you shielded me... Thank you...

records.jp: よかった……
でも何で私なんかを……井上にあんなひどいこと<CR>言っちゃったのに……
records.en_original: But why did you help me...? After we said such terrible things to you...
records.en_auxiliary: But why did you help me? After we said such terrible things to you.
records.en: But why did you help me...? After we said such terrible things to you...

records.jp: 今日はもうこれくらいにしましょう。続きはまた明日学校で……
records.en_original: That's enough for today. We can all talk tomorrow.
records.en_auxiliary: That's enough for today. We can all talk tomorrow.
records.en: That's enough for today. We can all talk tomorrow.

records.jp: 千紘立てる？<CR>今日は私が家まで送っていくよ
records.en_original: Can you stand up? I'll take you home today.
records.en_auxiliary: Can you stand up? I'll take you home today.
records.en: Can you stand up? I'll take you home today.

records.jp: うん、ありがとう……。日菜子……さん
それじゃあ、ちーちゃんが助けたの！？<CR>すごーい！！
records.en_original: You're saying Chii saved you!? That's awesome!!
records.en_auxiliary: You're saying Chii saved you?! That's awesome!
records.en: You're saying Chii-chan saved you!? That's awesome!!

records.jp: 自分を犠牲にして誰かを助けるなんてなかなかできないよね
records.en_original: You have to be pretty tough to put yourself in harm's way to save someone else.
records.en_auxiliary: You have to be pretty tough to put yourself in harm's way to save someone else.
records.en: You have to be pretty tough to put yourself in harm's way to save someone else.

records.jp: ホントだよ……。<CR>井上……ありがとう……！
この前の花壇に加えてちーちゃんのクラスでの人気急上昇だね
records.en_original: Add that to the flower beds, and Chi-chan's popularity is skyrocketing.
records.en_auxiliary: Add that to the flower beds, and Chii's popularity is skyrocketing.
records.en: With the flower beds and all, Chii-chan's popularity in class is skyrocketing.

records.jp: うん……。やってることだけ見たら聖人だもん
records.en_original: Yeah... She's the closest we've got to a saint, after all.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, she's the closest we've got to a saint, after all.
records.en: Yeah... She's the closest we've got to a saint, after all.

records.jp: ねえ、井上さん私とフリスペの連絡先交換してよ
records.en_original: Hey, Inoue? Let's exchange contact addresses on FreeSpace.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Inoue? Let's exchange contact addresses on FreeSpace.
records.en: Hey, Inoue-san? Let's exchange contact addresses on FreeSpace.

records.jp: 私も……いいかな？<CR>今度どっかに遊びに行こうよ！
records.en_original: Oh, can I get your address, too...? It'd be fun to hang out sometime!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, can I get your address, too? It'd be fun to hang out sometime!
records.en: Oh, can I get your address, too...? It'd be fun to hang out sometime!

records.jp: うぅ……
ち、千紘！
ヒナちゃん！　千紘ちゃんの様子、なんか変だったよ。<CR>急いで追いかけよう
records.en_original: Hina! Chihiro's acting kind of strange. We should hurry up and follow her.
records.en_auxiliary: Hina! Chihiro's acting kind of strange. We should hurry up and follow her.
records.en: Hina-chan! Chihiro-chan's acting kind of strange. We should hurry up and follow her.

records.jp: うん
千紘！
うぅ……
フラグメントが暴走してる……
話は後で……<CR>とにかく今は千紘のフラグメントを固定することを考えましょう
records.en_original: We'll talk later... Let's just think about stabilizing her Fragment for now.
records.en_auxiliary: We'll talk later. Let's focus on stabilizing her Fragment for now.
records.en: We'll talk later... Let's just think about stabilizing her Fragment for now.

records.jp: うん
